name: Moe Throws Barney
look: Three stacked panels from The Simpsons inside Moe's Tavern. Top: Moe grabs Barney by the shirt and shoves him out the door. Middle: Moe stands alone, dusting off his hands. Bottom: Barney is already back beside him, and Moe looks fed up.
use: Moe is you and Barney is something you try to get rid of. You throw it out, enjoy a moment of satisfaction, and it is immediately right back, like a bad habit, a bug or a song stuck in your head.
slots: who is doing the throwing (Moe, top panel)
the same thing, back again (Barney, bottom panel)
examples: The pile of clothes on the chair
